_comment: Chen-Pelger-Zhu data (download per README into datasets/). state_vars must be names from the macro file; run scripts/run_paper1.py --list_macro to print them. The FRED-MD mnemonics below are suggestions to replace with the names in your file.
_external_comment: kind F = SDF portfolio return (M = 1 - F), kind M = SDF; series cover train+valid+test in order. The notebook saves the CPZ GAN ensemble as sdf_normalized_ensemble.npy.
_factor_comment: Traded factor SDFs to audit: CSV with a date column (YYYYMMDD ints matching the npz dates) and excess-return factor columns, e.g. Ken French FF5 + UMD; b is estimated on the training split.
